commit.message:
fix(kiem-dong-wp): D2b — ban bung phai khop DANH MUC day du cua cay oid, ca thu muc (wp1236 dot C, luot 3)

Va theo LOP phan con mo cua C01 `archive-loc-mat-du-lieu-kiem` sau review ma luot 2
(ops/reviews/wp1236-c-r12-ma-2-codex tren nhanh ops/wp1236-bc-lease @ ed9d958).

- Lo: `git ls-tree -r` tran khong liet ke cay con, nen phep kiem trung khoa chi xet tep la.
  Cay co `A/note.txt` va `a/readback-...json`: hai la khac khoa, nhung nen gop `A` voi `a`
  thi `readback_thu_muc=.../A` nhan readback cua `a` (reviewer mo phong: rc 0, DAT).
- Nay ba luat, ba thong diep rc 8 rieng:
  1. ten trung khoa: moi muc cua `ls-tree -r -t` (tep, thu muc, symlink) khong duoc trung
     nhau sau NFC + casefold; kiem TRUOC khi bung.
  2. danh muc: tap (duong dan, loai) liet ke tu dia bang os.walk phai BANG dung danh muc
     cua cay, hai chieu. Liet ke chu khong tra theo ten: tra theo ten di qua dung phep
     gop ten cua nen (hoa/thuong, dau cham cuoi, ten danh rieng) nen khong thay no.
  3. noi dung: tep khop bam blob, va dich cua symlink cung khop bam blob.
- Cung co che, tu tim: bo loc `data` cua tarfile viet lai dich symlink (`./x` thanh `x`,
  `sub//y` thanh `sub/y`), nen dich tren dia khac blob trong git.

Test: 4 bien the trung khoa thu muc / thu muc-tep va doi chung anh em cung tien to;
4 bien the nen lam ban bung lech cay sau khi bung (gop, thua, thieu, viet lai dich);
12 dot bien rieng cho ba luat.

commit.message:
fix(kiem-dong-wp): D2b — K2 tinh symlink tro thu muc tren DANH MUC CAY, khong hoi nen (wp1236 dot C, luot 4)

Va lop `symlink-tren-dia-lech-cay` sau M3 Windows local do tren dbe650d
(#1236 issuecomment-7170894289; chu kho chon va trong write set, issuecomment-7170968907).

- Lo: tren Windows symlink mang LOAI (tep hay thu muc), gan luc tao. `git archive` xep
  `d` (-> sub) truoc `sub`, nen tarfile tao `d` thanh symlink TEP; `os.walk` cua module
  dot A xep no vao danh sach tep va K2 bo sot => D2b DAT (rc 0) thay vi rc 12.
  Do them tren may ay: symlink co dich chua "/" khong phan giai duoc, bat ke thu tu.
- Nay, nhanh passed, truoc khi goi kiem_tep: voi moi muc 120000 cua `ls-tree -r -t`,
  dich = posixpath.normpath(join(dirname(muc), readlink)). Dich la mot muc 040000 cua
  cay, hoac la goc ban bung => `kiem_tep:not_measured:symlink`, khong goi module.
  Chuoi readlink da duoc luat noi dung ghim bang bam blob ngay truoc do. Khong lenh nao
  hoi dia ve LOAI cua symlink. Pham vi K2 giu nguyen: symlink tep khong phai *.yaml
  van khong bi xet (chu kho chon giu pham vi K2).
- Doi hanh vi tren moi nen: cay co symlink tro thu muc thi D2b bao `symlink` truoc ca
  loi K1 cua tep danh gia (truoc day module bao ly do K1 truoc). Van rc 12.

Test: moc git_loi="tep" thay os.walk trong tien trinh de xep symlink tro thu muc vao
danh sach TEP (mo hinh Windows; tren ma dbe650d ba bien the nay ra rc 0, tuc tai hien
ca do M3). Fixture lk6 (dich "../../..", goc ban bung) va lk7 (dich co "/" toi thu muc
con + chuoi c -> e). 7 bien the moi trong cong_d2b_c4_symlink, 4 dot bien d2b_k2_*.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015GtxrZsYAFm7iLa11eWogL

Tra loi review ma luot 4 tren d5a7d85 (ops/reviews/wp1236-c-r12-ma-4-codex tren nhanh
ops/wp1236-bc-lease: C03 P1, C04 P2) theo quyet dinh chu kho o #1236 issuecomment-7180063460:
doi chot symlink tu "chan dich la thu muc" sang DANH SACH CHO PHEP.

- Lo (C03): chot luot 4 so dich voi danh muc THU MUC bang chuoi chinh xac, nen mot bi danh
  cua thu muc (khac hoa/thuong, dung dau cheo nguoc, khac NFC) khong nam trong danh muc va
  di lot khi nen xep symlink vao danh sach tep. Danh sach cam phai doan truoc moi cach viet.
- Nay, nhanh passed, truoc kiem_tep: moi muc 120000 cua `ls-tree -r -t <oid> -- <thu muc
  provenance>` chi qua khi posixpath.normpath(join(dirname(muc), readlink)) trung TUNG BYTE
  duong dan mot muc kieu tep cua chinh danh muc ay. Con lai => kiem_tep:not_measured:symlink:
  thu muc, goc ban bung, bi danh, dich hong, dich ngoai thu muc provenance, symlink khac.
- C04 (chan thua symlink hong khong phai yaml) nay la fail-closed co chu dich. Day la siet mot
  phan K2 so voi dac ta r12, chu kho da duyet; symlink tro dung tep thuong van qua (rc 0).
- Thay ba dong chot cu, khong cong them.

Test: _D2B_TC — 7 thu muc fixture, moi thu muc mot lop ten ngoai danh sach (bi danh thu muc,
bi danh tep, dau cheo nguoc, hong, ngoai thu muc provenance, tro symlink, NFD cua ten NFC);
17 dot bien d2b_k2_*, trong do 7 cai noi danh sach cho dung MOT ten tan cong.

commit.message:
fix(kiem-dong-wp): D2b — cam dau cheo nguoc tren duong dan dich va doi dich tho chuan tac (C05; wp1236 dot C, luot 6)

Tra loi review ma luot 5/6 tren 8aab9da (changes_requested: C05 P2) theo quyet dinh cua chu kho
o #1236 issuecomment-7182681531, bo sung cho luat danh sach cho phep (issuecomment-7180063460).

Mot symlink (120000) trong thu muc provenance nay chi qua khi ca ba dieu sau dung:
(a) join(dirname(link), readlink), TRUOC khi chuan hoa, khong mang dau cheo nguoc: ca dich tho lan
    thu muc chua link. Luot 5 chi so tung byte voi danh muc, nen tren POSIX mot tep mang dung ten
    co dau cheo nguoc lam link tro toi no lot voi rc 0 (reviewer do native tren 3.13.18 va 3.12.3);
(b) dich tho da o dang chuan tac: posixpath.normpath(d) == d. Bo bung cua Python truoc 3.12.11 /
    3.13.4 giu nguyen van ban dich, nen `a/../x` voi `a` vang (dich hong) tung chuan hoa ra dung
    mot tep thuong va lot. He qua co chu dich: `./x`, `a//b`, `sub/../x` cung bi chan;
(c) duong dan dich sau chuan hoa trung tung byte mot tep thuong cua danh muc (nhu luot 5).
Con lai tra kiem_tep:not_measured:symlink (rc 12) ma khong goi module.

Test: bang _D2B_TB (chi POSIX: Git for Windows khong nhan duong dan index mang dau cheo nguoc) co
nam thu muc ma cay CO THAT ten mang dau cheo nguoc (tep 100644, 100755, thanh phan thu muc, link
long, link nam trong thu muc ay); thu muc lkl va mo hinh git_loi="nguyen" (bo bung giu nguyen van
ban dich) cho dich hong khong chuan tac. Dot bien moi: bo_cam_cheo, cam_cheo_chi_dich_tho,
bo_chuan_tac; cho_ten_lka bo vi dieu cam rieng da chan lka.

Chua do: Windows voi Python >= 3.12.11 / 3.13.4 (data_filter dung ntpath.normpath, doi `/` trong
dich thanh dau cheo nguoc => cac bien the lk6, lk7, lkc se ra rc 8 thay vi rc 12).

fix(kiem-dong-wp): D2b — cam dau cheo nguoc tren duong dan dich va doi dich tho chuan tac (C05; wp1236 dot C, luot 6)

Tra loi review ma luot 5/6 tren 8aab9da (changes_requested: C05 P2) theo quyet dinh cua chu kho
o #1236 issuecomment-7182681531, bo sung cho luat danh sach cho phep (issuecomment-7180063460).

Mot symlink (120000) trong thu muc provenance nay chi qua khi ca ba dieu sau dung:
(a) join(dirname(link), readlink), TRUOC khi chuan hoa, khong mang dau cheo nguoc: ca dich tho lan
    thu muc chua link. Luot 5 chi so tung byte voi danh muc, nen tren POSIX mot tep mang dung ten
    co dau cheo nguoc lam link tro toi no lot voi rc 0 (reviewer do native tren 3.13.18 va 3.12.3);
(b) dich tho da o dang chuan tac: posixpath.normpath(d) == d. Bo bung cua Python truoc 3.12.11 /
    3.13.4 giu nguyen van ban dich, nen `a/../x` voi `a` vang (dich hong) tung chuan hoa ra dung
    mot tep thuong va lot. He qua co chu dich: `./x`, `a//b`, `sub/../x` cung bi chan;
(c) duong dan dich sau chuan hoa trung tung byte mot tep thuong cua danh muc (nhu luot 5).
Con lai tra kiem_tep:not_measured:symlink (rc 12) ma khong goi module.

Test: bang _D2B_TB (chi POSIX: Git for Windows khong nhan duong dan index mang dau cheo nguoc) co
nam thu muc ma cay CO THAT ten mang dau cheo nguoc (tep 100644, 100755, thanh phan thu muc, link
long, link nam trong thu muc ay); thu muc lkl va mo hinh git_loi="nguyen" (bo bung giu nguyen van
ban dich) cho dich hong khong chuan tac. Dot bien moi: bo_cam_cheo, cam_cheo_chi_dich_tho,
bo_chuan_tac; cho_ten_lka bo vi dieu cam rieng da chan lka.

Chua do: Windows voi Python >= 3.12.11 / 3.13.4 (data_filter dung ntpath.normpath, doi `/` trong
dich thanh dau cheo nguoc => cac bien the lk6, lk7, lkc se ra rc 8 thay vi rc 12).
